NavigationView.reason: NavigationView is a legacy navigation container superseded by NavigationStack and NavigationSplitView.

TextEditor.reason: Uses the shared controlled/uncontrolled Binding<String> adapter.

LazyVGrid.reason: GridItem sizing and dynamic children require a semantic grid adapter.

LazyHGrid.reason: GridItem sizing and dynamic children require a semantic grid adapter.

ViewThatFits.reason: Axis.Set is represented by a typed React prop while children preserve native SwiftUI composition.

searchable.reason: Uses controlled String and Bool bindings with named content and suggestions slots plus submit/change events.
searchable.uncoveredReason: Token and editable-token search overloads require typed collection identity and token-content adapters.

sheet.reason: Uses a controlled Bool presentation adapter with content and presented-content slots.
sheet.uncoveredReason: Item-driven presentation requires a typed identifiable-item bridge.

fullScreenCover.reason: Uses a controlled Bool presentation adapter with content and presented-content slots.
fullScreenCover.uncoveredReason: Item-driven presentation requires a typed identifiable-item bridge.

popover.reason: Uses a controlled Bool presentation adapter with content and presented-content slots.
popover.uncoveredReason: Item-driven presentation requires a typed identifiable-item bridge.

inspector.reason: Uses a controlled Bool inspector adapter with content and inspector slots.

focused.reason: Uses a controlled FocusState Bool adapter with focus change events.
focused.uncoveredReason: Arbitrary hashable focus values require a typed focus-domain adapter.

safeAreaInset.reason: Maps every safe-area edge to native SwiftUI with separate content and inset slots.

AsyncImage.reason: Uses native SwiftUI AsyncImage with typed URL and scale props, phase events, and placeholder and failure slots.
AsyncImage.uncoveredReason: Request-based and arbitrary Swift image/phase builder overloads are not equivalent to the typed React phase surface.

Table.reason: Maps serializable string-keyed rows and dynamic column definitions to native SwiftUI Table with controlled single selection.
Table.uncoveredReason: Generic row builders, key paths, sorting, multi-selection, outlines, and column customization require additional typed adapters.

toolbar.reason: The reviewed Expo Toolbar component maps wrapped content and a named toolbar-content slot to native SwiftUI toolbar semantics.

navigationDestination.reason: The reviewed Expo NavigationDestination component maps string path values to native NavigationStack destinations.

alert.reason: The reviewed Expo Alert component provides native SwiftUI alert presentation with typed actions.

confirmationDialog.reason: The reviewed Expo ConfirmationDialog component provides native SwiftUI confirmation-dialog presentation.

App.reason: An App declaration owns process lifecycle and cannot be embedded as MiniApp child UI.

Scene.reason: A Scene declaration belongs to the Hanlin host lifecycle.

WindowGroup.reason: Window creation belongs to the Hanlin host lifecycle.

DocumentGroup.reason: Document scene ownership is not meaningful inside an embedded MiniApp.

Settings.reason: Settings scene ownership belongs to the host application.

Commands.reason: Application command registration belongs to the host lifecycle.

ImmersiveSpace.reason: Immersive scene creation is not an embedded iOS MiniApp view capability.

environmentObject.reason: Generic object identity and lifetime cannot be serialized safely across the React bridge.

preference.reason: Arbitrary PreferenceKey associated-value semantics are not serializable.

onPreferenceChange.reason: Arbitrary PreferenceKey values and callbacks require a deliberate typed adapter.
